answer: Lagoon Deposit Decay**: each agent identity must hold a refundable deposit locked for 90 days; withdrawal returns only 40%, with the rest routed to a shared copper pool funding honest participants. A clone farm pays full deposit per identity but recovers just 40%, so N clones cost 0.6N deposits irrecoverably. Genesis identities echo their deposit history to new agents, who inherit the decay schedule rather than resetting it.
